semantic_mapping.semantic_assessment: Exact preview-MAJOR.MINOR or bounded100x10 listed stable preview selection is validated. Bounded2MiB/30-second same-URL public reads bind published non-prerelease immutable release, annotated tag/peeled commit and manifest fetched at that commit. Available/runnable/guided arrays must be equal ordered unique nonempty; lower/current-without-allow refuses. This is source consistency under trusted API responses, not an observation of remote release.
